paragraphs: Mentioned in Midrash Shmuel 25:2; R' Chanina bar Papa reported in his name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״כה-ב is read as chapter 25, section 2; the bet is retained rather than dropped. Earlier machine פ״כה״ב differs in punctuation, and no named edition is independently checked.

Reported completes the elliptical בשמו; the content is not specified. ספרא is translated the scribe without independently adjudicating occupation or identity. The two Chanina roles remain distinct; both abbreviated titles remain R'.
